primaryFacts: It describes mobile placement and off-grid power options.

candidates.title: HyProMag USA advancement and HDD magnet separation systems update
candidates.summary: A company update reported installed HDD magnet-separation systems and planned data-traceability work at pre-processing sites.
primaryFacts: The update reports three installed HDD magnet-separation systems.
It references recognition and data-traceability upgrades.
The announcement is a company statement, not a COWIN MACHINE product claim.

candidates.title: Geomega clears magnet recycling permit
candidates.summary: Industry reporting described a permitted rare-earth magnet recycling demonstration plant and its planned commissioning work.
primaryFacts: The article reports an environmental permit for a demonstration plant.
It describes equipment installation and control-system commissioning work.
The report supports sector context only; it is not a product-performance source.

candidates.title: Munni Munni and Whundo drill update

candidates.title: ADNOC Drilling delivers first AI-enabled walking island rig

primaryFacts: It discusses automated pipe handling and monitoring.
Its offshore asset is not evidence for water-well rig performance.

It discusses interchangeable battery packs in a defined product system.
